jsonld.name: Mobile Mechanic R&R
jsonld.description: Mobile auto repair service based in Miami, FL. The mechanic and the trailer come straight to the customer's home, office or parking garage for diagnostics, alternators, fuel systems, timing belts, brakes and general repair.

parrafo.es: Mobile Mechanic R&R lleva un taller completo hasta tu casa, tu oficina o el garaje de tu edificio en Miami. Ronil diagnostica y repara ahí mismo: alternadores, baterías, bombas de combustible, correas de distribución, frenos y más, sin grúa y sin dejar tu auto en un taller ajeno.
parrafo.en: Mobile Mechanic R&R brings a fully equipped shop straight to your home, office or building garage anywhere in Miami. Ronil diagnoses and repairs it on the spot: alternators, batteries, fuel pumps, timing belts, brakes and more, no tow truck and no leaving your car with strangers.

hero.imagen_alt: Mechanic from Mobile Mechanic R&R working under the hood of a Toyota Supra in a customer's home garage

parrafo_1.es: Mobile Mechanic R&R es un servicio móvil con base en Miami. Ronil, el mecánico detrás del negocio, llega con un tráiler totalmente equipado (gato, generador, máquina de llantas, balanceadora, herramienta eléctrica) directo a donde esté tu auto, así el diagnóstico y la reparación pasan ahí mismo.
parrafo_1.en: Mobile Mechanic R&R is a Miami-based mobile repair service. Ronil, the mechanic behind it, shows up with a fully equipped trailer (jack, generator, tire machine, wheel balancer, power tools) wherever your car already is, so the diagnosis and the repair happen right there.

parrafo_2.es: Lo que se repite en las reseñas de Google es siempre lo mismo: responde rápido, explica el problema con claridad y cobra un precio razonable antes de empezar. 265 reseñas y una calificación de 4.8 respaldan eso.
parrafo_2.en: The same things come up again and again in the Google reviews: a fast response, a clear explanation of the problem and a fair price agreed before any work starts. 265 reviews and a 4.8 rating back that up.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué le pasa a tu auto al (305) 218-9761. Ronil responde directo, sin central telefónica ni app de citas.
texto.en: Tell us what's going on with your car at (305) 218-9761. Ronil answers directly, no call center and no appointment app.

texto.es: Nos das tu dirección (casa, oficina o garaje del edificio) en Miami y acordamos un horario que te convenga.
texto.en: You give us your address, home, office or building garage, anywhere in Miami, and we agree on a time that works for you.

texto.es: El tráiler equipado llega justo a donde está tu auto. Nada de grúa ni de dejarlo esperando en un taller.
texto.en: The fully equipped trailer pulls up right where your car already is. No tow truck and no dropping it off to wait in line.

texto.es: Ronil te explica qué tiene el auto y cuánto cuesta antes de tocar nada, y en la mayoría de los casos lo resuelve en el momento.
texto.en: Ronil explains what's wrong and what it costs before touching anything, and in most cases fixes it on the spot.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza después de que Ronil revisa tu auto en persona o escucha los síntomas por teléfono. Llama o escribe y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted after Ronil takes a look at your car in person or hears the symptoms over the phone. Call or text and we'll walk you through it, no obligation.

texto.es: De una batería muerta a un alternador completo, reemplazado en tu propia entrada para que no te quedes esperando una grúa.
texto.en: From a dead battery to a full alternator swap, replaced right in your driveway so you're not stuck waiting on a tow.

texto.es: Clientes describen a Ronil encontrando el problema real rápido, desde una luz de check engine hasta algo que otro taller no vio, y explicándolo antes de tocar el auto.
texto.en: Customers describe Ronil finding the real problem fast, from a check-engine light to something another shop missed, and explaining it before touching the car.

texto.es: Reemplazo de bombas de combustible y reparación de correas de distribución resueltos en el sitio, desde autos económicos hasta Mercedes-Benz y Honda.
texto.en: Fuel pump replacements and timing belt repairs handled on site, from everyday cars to Mercedes-Benz and Honda engines.

texto.es: Servicio de frenos, trabajos de suspensión y reparaciones generales en todo tipo de auto, del uso diario a los de alto rendimiento.
texto.en: Brake service, suspension work and general repairs on every kind of car, from daily drivers to high-performance builds.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu problema en la lista? Llama igual y describe qué pasa: la mayoría de los trabajos empiezan con una llamada rápida.
pie.en: Don't see your issue listed? Call anyway and describe what's going on: most jobs start with a quick phone call.

subtitulo.es: Reseñas reales de clientes en Miami, tomadas de nuestra ficha de Google.
subtitulo.en: Real reviews from customers across Miami, taken from our Google listing.

items.quote: Ronil is very experienced and fast. He installed a new alternator in my van for an extremely good price! I will definitely be calling him in the future and referring him to friends. Seriously, call him first if you're getting quotes!

Rony came and answered all my questions and was able to diagnose the issue. The man is quick and very honest. I will recommend him to my friends and family. My issue was a fuel pump for my Mercedes Benz and he was able to find the part, fix the problem, and charge a reasonable price. Thank you Rony!

Highly recommended mobile Tech! My Honda Accord timing belt snapped along with a fluid leak and Ronil was able to repair the issue providing clear communications and advise on properly maintaining the car. Great reasonable price overall!

parrafo.en: One call or text and we start: tell Ronil what's going on with your car and where it's parked. He'll give you the details before doing any work, no obligation.
